description: Returns how the prices of every market in an event changed over time, one series per market, for charting or trend analysis. Each point has a UTC `time` and `price_percent`, the market's price as a percentage from 0 to 100 (50 means 0.50). Takes an EVENT id, not a market id. Long series are thinned evenly (first and last point kept) to `max_points` per series; `total_points` tells you how many existed.

id.description: Event id, as returned by get_markets. Not a market id.

max_points.description: Maximum points returned per market series, 2 to 2000. Default 100.

time_interval.description: Look-back window ending now: day (24 hours), week (7 days), month (31 days), year (365 days) or all_time. Defaults to all_time.

name: get_price_history
title: Get price history
